items.abstract_or_text: We built a robotics data engine with Astra-level performance at 125x lower cost. And we are open-sourcing the weights today! Introducing Flora, a suite of open models to parse the physical world and turn raw footage into rich training signals. Flora already powers our in-house data engine, labeling 200K hours of videos a day on 500 GPUs. We created it to scale the frontier for robot learning. Now you own the weights too. Flora gives you: - High-quality, timestamped captions to curate and filter human egocentric and robot data; - Dense progress rewards for quality control and RL post-training; - Rubrics scoring for real-world benchmarking Try it today, links in thread:

items.abstract_or_text: OpenAI、Anthropic 花越来越多的钱把模型训练得更聪明，结果开发者越来越不愿意为这点聪明买单。 《The Information》最近分析了 OpenRouter 的使用数据，发现了两个很夸张的变化： 2025 年底，模型智力评分每领先 10 分，平均能多获得 69% 的开发者流量。现在，这个优势只剩下 20%。 智力排名前十的模型，占 OpenRouter Token 使用量的比例，也从 2025 年初的 55% 跌到了今年第三季度的 14%。

items.title: @scidonia_ai：Can a theorem prover run production-grade backend infrastructure? We built LeanIn, a concurrency runtime with a work-ste
items.abstract_or_text: Can a theorem prover run production-grade backend infrastructure? We built LeanIn, a concurrency runtime with a work-stealing scheduler for Lean 4, to find out. By borrowing architectural cues from Tokio and Node (specifically using defunctionalisation rather than closure-heavy do notation), the benchmark numbers on HTTP/1.1 speak for themselves: ⚡ 2.3x to 3.0x faster than Node 22 on pipelined traffic, topping out over 512,000 req/s (C=8). Lean 4 is proving it isn't just a good option as a proof assistant, it is a viable, high-performance foundation for verified systems software.
